delegatecall_context.meaning: the call executes in a delegatecall context where address(this) resolves to the user's wallet/shim

direct_call_context.meaning: injectSweepAndCall is invoked directly on the router contract (not via delegatecall), so address(this) is the router

router_holds_user_funds.meaning: the router has accumulated and controls user funds, i.e. it is a stateful asset custodian

user_funds_available.meaning: a user has sent funds to the router expecting stateless routing behavior

assumptions: The report's scenario is conditional: a direct call to injectSweepAndCall is possible because no delegatecall-only guard exists.
Permissionlessness of injectSweepAndCall is inferred only from the missing guard.
Funds are transferred from msg.sender into address(this) during the call.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether a direct call was actually observed; the direct-call scenario is conditional.

limitations: Formalizes only the router-custody impact; drain and stuck-funds impacts are handled in separate passes.
direct_call_context and delegatecall_context are qualitative context Booleans grounded in the report's delegatecall-only intent and missing-guard statements; runtime binding is deferred.
